Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Preserve scope and constraints. Do not invent context, requirements, or missing information. Do not perform the task.", "input": "i’m at a campsite and the trailer isn’t getting power from the 30-amp pedestal. can you help me figure out what to do, but keep the answer tied to what i can see at the connection? if the pedestal’s 30-amp outlet and my shore-power cord have no visible cracks, scorch marks, or moisture, give me a short checklist for checking whether the site breaker has tripped and, if it has, how to reset it. if even one of those signs is there, don’t give me steps to touch or reset the connection; instead, write a brief message i can send to the campground host asking them to inspect the power connection. i only need one branch, whichever applies to those conditions. please return only the checklist or the host message, not both, and don’t add an introduction or extra advice. make the checklist concise and make the message straightforward, so i can use the appropriate one at the campsite.", "output": "Help me address the loss of power to my trailer from the campsite’s 30-amp pedestal. Use the visible condition of the connection to choose one of these two responses:

- If the pedestal’s 30-amp outlet and my shore-power cord have no visible cracks, scorch marks, or moisture, provide a short checklist for checking whether the site breaker has tripped and, if it has, how to reset it.
- If any one of those signs is present, do not give me steps to touch or reset the connection. Instead, write a brief message I can send to the campground host asking them to inspect the power connection.

Return only the applicable checklist or host message—not both. Do not include an introduction or extra advice. Keep the checklist concise and the message straightforward."}]
